scope: Each of the 29 production requests (validation/2026-10-04-production-buff-toggles/requests) with one change to a raid buff, party buff, individual buff or debuff the production application's builder names (web/src/lib/forever-assumption-items.ts BUFF_NAMES and DEBUFF_NAMES): a boolean turned on when off and removed when on; a tristate (Battle Shout, Mana Spring Totem) set to each level it does not have, Regular, Improved or Missing. Each request also runs unchanged.

criteria.comparison: full RaidSimResult except elapsedNs, lists keyed by ID

notes: Fixed in this branch from the first run (868 matched, 31 rejected): a caster's party Windfury Totem, which Go gives no extra attack and no spell can trigger, was unrepresented (10 variants); a party Grace of Air beside a party Windfury Totem was unrepresented, although Go's air totem slot lets Windfury Totem displace it during the reset (18 variants); Rust now turns the Windfury Totem trigger on in the totem's exclusive effect, after the displacement, as Go does; and the exporter keeps a spell action ID that is only a tag, which Go lists in the metrics.

The three Warlock variants with the raid's Curse of the Elements, rejected before, match since the Warlock owner's fix (22219e5): the raid's curse holds the exclusive category, so Go blocks the Warlock's own curse on every landed cast and the production rotations recast it every GCD, at a much lower DPS.

Rerun against the coordinator branch at 0705079, which carries this branch's fixes and the Warlock fix; regression fixtures balance-druid-party-windfury-totem and warrior-party-grace-of-air-and-windfury.
The builder only switches assumptions off; turning one on and the tristate levels go beyond it, as requests a user can send through the API.
